en-US.description: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows.
en-US.longDescription: A local-first AI workspace for multi-agent chat, coding, and visual workflows. Available as a desktop app and self-hosted web console, with support for Hermes Agent, Ekko Agent, and 14 coding-agent integrations, including Claude Code and Codex. Bring conversations, group collaboration, voice, files, and devices together in one place.

zh-CN.description: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。
zh-CN.longDescription: 本地优先的 AI 工作区，支持多 Agent 聊天、编码和可视化工作流。提供桌面应用和可自托管的 Web 控制台，支持 Hermes Agent、Ekko Agent，以及包含 Claude Code、Codex 在内的 14 种 Coding Agent 集成。在同一个工作区中管理对话、群组协作、语音、文件和设备。
zh-CN.name: Ekko Studio
zh-CN.releaseNotes:
更新重点
- 新增主题实时自定义，可按界面区域设置背景、透明度、模糊、圆角、边框和阴影，并支持命名主题、复制、切换及账号保存 (#3394)。
- 完善 GIF、动态 WebP 和 APNG 壁纸支持，壁纸上限提升至 30 MB，主题 ZIP 上限提升至 32 MB；上传、缓存、导入和导出均保留动画 (#3399)。
- 修复小屏下工作流执行记录抽屉宽度不足和背景透明的问题 (#3398)。
- 修复群聊 AI 消息主题同步，消除消息气泡及表格中的重复背景和模糊 (#3398)。
- 统一模型可见性设置在模型选择器中的生效范围，并为大型模型目录增加性能提示 (#3392)。
- 可见模型管理新增搜索功能 (#3393)。
- Provider 完整模型目录改为按需加载，减少配置页的首次请求量 (#3401)。
- 将新建聊天的分类选择移至输入框工具栏 (#3389)。
- 完善 Windows 盘符根目录工作区处理，并保留文件路径中的首尾空格 (#3396)。
- 修复带版本标记的 Hermes Runtime 打包兼容性 (#3400)。
- 新增随版本发布自动构建和校验 TOS 7 x86_64 测试安装包的流程 (#3397)。
- Studio 与桌面端版本同步更新为 0.7.36，前端更新日志覆盖 12 种语言并保留最近三个版本 (#3399)。
What's Changed
- [codex] honor model visibility and warn about large catalogs by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3392
- [codex] add search to visible model management by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3393
- [codex] move new-chat category picker into composer toolbar by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3389
- [codex] add live theme customization and portable theme presets by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3394
- [codex] build TOS 7 packages automatically on release publication by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3397
- [codex] fix workflow drawers and chat message themes by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3398
- [codex] complete Windows drive-root workspace handling without trimming file paths by @wtj-0527 in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3396
- [codex] package Hermes releases with install-stamp version identity by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3400
- [codex] prepare 0.7.36 with 30 MB animated wallpapers by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3399
- [codex] load full provider model catalogs on demand by @EKKOLearnAI in https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/pull/3401
Full Changelog: https://github.com/EKKOLearnAI/ekko-studio/compare/v0.7.35...v0.7.36
